messages.content: Arroyo House confirmed both Saturday massages, but there are two changes: the main mineral pool is closed Friday morning, and the $150 spa credit is once per room, not per guest. Recalculate this against Desert Palms and tell me which one to book.

Using the confirmed figures, Arroyo House is $2,332.80 for lodging plus $490 for the two massages, less one $150 spa credit, for a trip total of $2,672.80 before treatment gratuities. The credit clarification removes $150 of value if the earlier comparison assumed two credits. Desert Palms remains $2,086.40 for lodging, provided the parking charge is removed, plus the quoted $455 for its massage and facial, totaling $2,541.40 before gratuities. Desert Palms is therefore $131.40 less.
How much weight would you give the pool closure? We arrive Thursday evening, so Friday morning would otherwise be our first chance to use it.

It is a real inconvenience, but limited: Arroyo's main mineral pool would be unavailable only Friday morning, with access expected afterward for Friday afternoon through Monday. I would confirm that another soaking pool remains open during maintenance and that the reopening time is guaranteed. Desert Palms has uninterrupted pool access, so it wins on that part of the stay.
But Desert Palms still cannot put both of us into treatments at the same time on Saturday, correct?

Correct. Its available Saturday schedule is still the 1:00 p.m. massage and 3:30 p.m. facial, so the appointments are staggered and are different services. Arroyo has confirmed two 80-minute massages together at 2:00 p.m. Saturday.
Then make the decision. The point of this weekend is time together, but I do not want to overpay based on a package description that was misleading.

Book Arroyo House, subject to one final written confirmation. The corrected premium is $131.40, not $281.40, and it buys the paired Saturday massages while the pool disruption affects only Friday morning. Before payment, obtain the complete $2,332.80 lodging total, $1,166.40 deposit, November 4 cancellation cutoff with local time, breakfast for two, one $150 room-level credit applicable across both massages, and confirmation that both 2:00 p.m. appointments remain held. Also verify the exact pool closure and reopening times, what alternate mineral facilities stay open, and whether maintenance could extend. If any of those terms changes, use Desert Palms at the confirmed $2,541.40 combined total. Nothing has been booked.
